semiconductor_relevance: High — UniTemp GmbH develops and manufactures specialized thermal process equipment for the microelectronics semiconductor industry.
summary: UniTemp GmbH focuses on the development, manufacturing, and sales of equipment tailored for the microelectronics sector. Their product offerings include reflow soldering systems, rapid thermal processing ovens, and semi-automatic wire bonders, catering to various applications in semiconductor fabrication and research.
capabilities: Reflow soldering systems with vacuum chambers
Rapid thermal processing ovens (RTP) for dopant activation and thermal oxidation
